After that, it should save and close the EDB, open it in Hfss 3D Layout to generate the 3D model, and export the layout to Q3D. The code should then launch the newly created Q3D project, plot it, and assign sources and sinks on nets using the previously calculated positions. It should create a setup and a frequency sweep from DC to 2GHz, analyze the project, compute ACL and ACR solutions, plot them, and finally, release the desktop.

```python
import os
import tempfile
import shutil
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pyaedt import Edb, Hfss3dLayout, Q3d, Desktop, download_kit_files, examples
from pyaedt.generic.general_methods import download_file

# Set up AEDT Desktop
desktop_version = "2023.2"
non_graphical = True
new_thread = True
Desktop(desktop_version, non_graphical, new_thread)

# Set up temporary project directory
tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
project_name = "pcb_analysis"
edb_project_name = "pcb_project.aedb"
q3d_project_name = "pcb_q3d.aedt"
edb_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, edb_project_name)
q3d_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, q3d_project_name)

# Download example EDB project file
example_edb_url = "https://github.com/pyansys/PyAEDT_Examples/raw/main/EDB/ANSYS_EDB_Example.aedb.tar.gz"
download_file(example_edb_url, destination_folder=tmp_dir, overwrite=True)
shutil.unpack_archive(os.path.join(tmp_dir, "ANSYS_EDB_Example.aedb.tar.gz"), tmp_dir)
edb_folder = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "ANSYS_EDB_Example.aedb")

# Open EDB project
edb = Edb(edb_folder, edbversion=desktop_version)

# Select nets for cutout
selected_nets = ["VCC", "GND"]
cutout = edb.cutout(create_cutout=True, nets=selected_nets)

# Export cutout to Q3D
edb.export_to_q3d(q3d_path)

# Identify pin locations on components for source/sink assignment
pin_locations = {}
for comp in edb.components.components.values():
    for pin in comp.pins.values():
        pos = pin.position
        z = edb.stackup.get_layer_z_position(pin.layer)
        pin_locations[pin.name] = (pos[0], pos[1], z)

# Save and close EDB
edb.save_edb()
edb.close_edb()

# Open in Hfss 3D Layout to generate 3D model and export to Q3D
hfss3d = Hfss3dLayout(edb_folder, specified_version=desktop_version)
hfss3d.export_to_q3d(q3d_path)
hfss3d.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=False)

# Launch Q3D project
q3d = Q3d(q3d_path, specified_version=desktop_version)

# Plot the Q3D model
q3d.plot(show=True)

# Assign sources and sinks on nets using pin locations
source_pins = [k for k in pin_locations if "1" in k][:1]
sink_pins = [k for k in pin_locations if "2" in k][:1]
if source_pins and sink_pins:
    source_pin = source_pins[0]
    sink_pin = sink_pins[0]
    source_pos = pin_locations[source_pin]
    sink_pos = pin_locations[sink_pin]
    q3d.create_source(source_pin, source_pos)
    q3d.create_sink(sink_pin, sink_pos)

# Create setup and frequency sweep from DC to 2GHz
setup = q3d.create_setup("Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "2GHz"
setup.update()
q3d.create_linear_count_sweep(setupname="Setup1", unit="GHz", freqstart=0, freqstop=2, num_of_freq_points=201, sweepname="Sweep1")

# Analyze the project
q3d.analyze_setup("Setup1")

# Compute ACL and ACR solutions
acl = q3d.get_ac_loss("Setup1", "Sweep1")
acr = q3d.get_ac_resistance("Setup1", "Sweep1")

# Plot ACL and ACR
plt.figure()
plt.plot(acl["freq"], acl["acl"], label="ACL")
plt.plot(acr["freq"], acr["acr"], label="ACR")
plt.xlabel("Frequency (Hz)")
plt.ylabel("Loss / Resistance")
plt.legend()
plt.title("ACL and ACR vs Frequency")
plt.show()

# Release the desktop
q3d.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)

# Clean up temporary directory
shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir)
```
